title: Privacy-Preserving Synthetic Data Generator
summary: A Streamlit application that trains a tabular generative model to produce privacy-safe synthetic datasets for domains such as healthcare and finance, adding differential-privacy (DP-SGD) training via Opacus and evaluating fidelity, privacy, and utility metrics. It imports CTGAN directly from the standalone ctgan package and extends its training loop with a custom DP mechanism.
evidence: model_train.py:10 'from ctgan import CTGAN' combined with opacus PrivacyEngine for DP-SGD training
needs: requirements.txt lists sdv>=0.17.0 but no sdv.* import is shown; only the standalone ctgan package is used in the code, so the sdv dependency itself is unverified/unused.
